scopeInterpretation.registeredU03Families: The registered family/action names identify bounded source-pose observations. Passive surface deformation accompanying a pose is not a prime-mover claim, muscle activation, or a physiological contraction clip.
scopeInterpretation.scapularSuperiorRotation: R2 is explicitly scapula/clavicle-only; humerus and distal-arm movement are excluded/fixed. It is not full scapulohumeral rhythm or complete shoulder-girdle coupling.
scopeInterpretation.wristRadialDeviation: Current registered candidate uses revision R3 at signed +/-7 degrees across sides. R2 +/-4 degrees was an intermediate range after the wider R1 trial had new containment; R3 restores the original authored observation range using a different source-derived pivot. Neither range is physiological ROM.
scopeInterpretation.qualitativeActionEvidence: Action labels/qualitative direction evidence remain distinct from muscle prime-mover status; the only existing main-function clip remains the separately recorded T59 right tibialis anterior clip.
scopeInterpretation.sideAndPart: Exact source side and member selectors remain package-level scope. Candidate registration does not approve all parts, a full group extent, or a broader target.

wristRadialDeviationLeft.rotationOrder: entire exact source carpal/hand chain deviates around source-derived radius-scaphoid contact reference; authored 7 degree observation only, not normal ROM
scopeAndLimits: R3 restores the original 7 degree candidate and changes only the authored pivot derivation to the actual registered radius/scaphoid source surface interface; the earlier 4 degree range is not carried forward.

Whole target/group extent and continuous collision freedom are not approved.
